scope: Corollary 8.2 (A half-plane mean with fixed nearby endpoints) of the manuscript “Radial transfer estimates and polygon length laws for honeycomb walks” (preprints/Radial-transfer-estimates-and-polygon-length-laws-for-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 02d2e8df0dcf370b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 51. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Take the upper half-plane above the row cut through the midpoints of the vertical bonds below the Pi,0. Consider all SAWs there from P0,0 to P1,0, weighted by xℓ ∗, where ℓ is edge length. Under this normalized weight, conditional on diameter at least R, the mean length is R4/3+o(1) as R → ∞. The same conclusion holds on R ≤ diam < R1+ϵ for every fixed ϵ > 0.
